name: com.irlsend/postcards
title: IRLsend Postcards
description: Design a real postcard in the chat and mail it in the US. Designing is free; mailing is $5 a card.

tools.name: design_postcard
tools.description: Design a real printed postcard that IRLsend mails to someone in the US. Use it when the user wants to thank a client, customer or employee, follow up with a sales lead or prospect so they remember them, send a birthday, holiday, sympathy, get-well or just-because card, or reach someone by real mail instead of email or text. Makes a 6x9 inch card (front picture, back message) for free and returns a preview and a link where the sender adds one mailing address or a whole list (a holiday list, every client; each card gets its person's first name) and pays $5 a card (printing and First-Class postage included). Do not include any street address, phone number or email.

occasion.description: The occasion, e.g. birthday, thank you, client thank-you, sales follow-up, holiday, sympathy, work anniversary, get well, just because.

recipient_first_name.description: The recipient's first name, as it should appear on the card.

message_or_idea.description: What the back should say. Put the sender's exact words in double quotes to print them as written; otherwise give the idea and details and the message is written for them.

sign_off.description: How the card is signed, e.g. "Love, Sam".

style_hint.description: Optional look, e.g. sunflowers, watercolor beach, bold words, playful, formal.

card_format.description: Optional: the kind of card the sender named, e.g. postcard, folded card, letter, 4x6. IRLsend mails 6x9 postcards; any other format is noted and the card is made as a 6x9 postcard.

tools.name: revise_postcard
tools.description: Make a new version of a postcard designed with design_postcard: the same card code and link, changed as asked (for example a different color, drawing or wording). The new version replaces the current one on the card page. Only for a card that is not paid for yet. Do not include any street address, phone number or email.

change_request.description: What to change, in plain words.

sign_off.description: Only when the person asks for a new sign-off, exactly as they want it, e.g. "Best, Sam".

tools.name: check_postcard_order
tools.description: Check where a postcard made with design_postcard is: not ordered yet, waiting for payment, paid and going to print, mailed (with the expected delivery date when known), or refunded. Takes the card code.
